# TalentFlow

> TalentFlow is recruitment operations software for recruitment agencies and independent recruiters.

TalentFlow connects recruitment CRM and applicant tracking workflows with client candidate submissions, interviews, recruitment automation, placements, invoices and payment tracking.

## Primary pages
- / — Product overview and pricing
- /careers — Current recruitment opportunities
- /privacy — Privacy information
- /candidate-terms — Candidate terms
- /accessibility — Accessibility information

## Product facts
- Recruitment CRM and candidate/application tracking
- Client candidate review workflows
- Interview management
- Recruitment automation
- Placement and commercial tracking
- Client invoices and payment ledger
- Starter, Growth and Scale subscription plans

Private account, client and candidate portal pages are not intended for indexing.
